shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
git diff package.json; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/catalog/page.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && grep -rl "unstable_prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -rn "runtime" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js | head -20

sed -n 85,125p node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js; echo ----; grep -n "runtime" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cache-stages.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cache-stages.js | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn "cacheLife.*prefetch\|'prefetch'\|stages" node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/router-utils/cache-life-type-utils.js | head -20
sed -n 1,80p node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js; echo ----; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cache-stages.d.ts

ls node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/ | grep -i instant; grep -rln "instant" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ----; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/next -iname "*instant*" | grep -v "\.map$" | head
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/ | grep -i prefetch; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md

grep -n "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; echo ----; sed -n 1,400p node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md | grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "use cache\|prefetch={true}\|searchParams" | head -150
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | grep -n "NEXT_ROUTER\|RSC_HEADER\|NEXT_URL\|NEXT_HTML" | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER\]\|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER\]\|'runtime'\|PrefetchKind\|isRuntimePrefetch" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -30
sed -n 1640,1690p node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "server up"
echo "=== App Shell prefetch (header 3) for ?category=sale ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 3" -H "next-url: /" | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Loading category\.\.\.\|Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch (header 2) for ?category=sale, first request (cold cache) ==="
time (curl -s "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" -D /tmp/h1 | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Loading category\.\.\.\|Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort | uniq -c)
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch (header 2) for ?category=sale, second request (warm cache) ==="
time (curl -s "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Loading category\.\.\.\|Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort | uniq -c)
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch for ?category=featured ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=featured" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Loading category\.\.\.\|Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort | uniq -c
grep -i "x-nextjs\|vary\|cache-control" /tmp/h1
cat /tmp/next-start.log | tail -5; echo ----; curl -s -i "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | head -c 3000

check() { tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Loading category\.\.\.\|Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket" | sort | uniq -c; }
echo "=== App Shell prefetch (header 3) for ?category=sale ==="
curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 3" -H "next-url: /" | check
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch (header 2) for ?category=sale, cold ==="
time (curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" -D /tmp/h1 | check)
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch (header 2) for ?category=sale, warm ==="
time (curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | check)
echo "=== Per-link runtime prefetch for ?category=featured ==="
curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=featured" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | check
grep -i "^x-nextjs\|^vary\|^cache-control\|^HTTP" /tmp/h1
curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /" | tr -d '\0' | grep -n "Loading category\|Products on sale" | cut -c1-600

(npx next dev -p 3124 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3124/ && break; sleep 1; done
curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/catalog?category=sale"; curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/catalog?category=featured"; sleep 4
curl -sL -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/catalog?category=sale" -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" -H "next-url: /"; sleep 3
grep -iv "^$" /tmp/next-dev.log | tail -30
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next dev"; sleep 1; echo stopped
git status --short; echo ----; git diff tsconfig.json; cat .gitignore
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts && git status --short && echo ---- && git diff -- app lib next.config.ts
sleep 2; pgrep -fa "next" | grep -v pgrep; rm -rf .next; git status --short && echo ---- && git diff -- app lib next.config.ts
pkill -f "next dev" ; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa "next" | grep -v pgrep | grep -v run.mjs; rm -rf .next; git status --short
pgrep -fa "next" | grep -v pgrep | grep -v run.mjs; ls -a | grep -c "^.next$"; git status --short
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts && git status --short
